Gary Vaynerchuk · 2013 · 8-minute brief

Jab, Jab, Jab, Right Hook

A field guide to social media as a boxing match: give value repeatedly in the native language of each platform, then, and only then, ask for the sale.
Cover of Jab, Jab, Jab, Right Hook
Cover of Jab, Jab, Jab, Right Hook
At a glance
Author Gary Vaynerchuk
Published 2013
Shelf Business & Leadership
Subject Marketing & Sales
Read time 8 min

In brief

Vaynerchuk argues that most businesses lose on social media because they throw right hooks, sales pitches, without first landing jabs: small, generous pieces of content that entertain or help and ask for nothing. Each platform has its own dialect, and content that ignores it reads as an advertisement and is skipped.
